🎥🕷️: Spider-Man 3 (2007)

Peter Parker finally seems to have found balance between his life as Spider-Man and his relationship with Mary Jane, but everything begins falling apart when new enemies and Peter’s own growing ego push him down a darker path.

While Flint Marko is transformed into the powerful Sandman, Peter discovers a shocking connection between Marko and his past. At the same time, Harry Osborn embraces his father’s legacy and seeks revenge against Peter. Things become even more dangerous when a mysterious alien symbiote attaches itself to Spider-Man, giving Peter greater power while bringing out the worst parts of his personality.

With his relationships crumbling and Venom eventually emerging as another deadly threat, Peter must confront his anger, pride, and desire for revenge before they destroy everything he cares about.

source_details.synopsis: Spider-Man 3 is a 2007 American superhero film directed by Sam Raimi, who co-wrote it with his brother Ivan and Alvin Sargent. Based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man, it is the final film in Raimi's Spider-Man trilogy and the sequel to Spider-Man 2 (2004). Tobey Maguire stars as Peter Parker / Spider-Man, alongside Kirsten Dunst, James Franco, Thomas Haden Church, Topher Grace, Bryce Dallas Howard, James Cromwell, Rosemary Harris, and J. K. Simmons. Set a year after the events of Spider-Man 2, the film follows Peter as he prepares for his future with his girlfriend Mary Jane Watson, while facing the Sandman, Venom, and his vengeful friend Harry Osborn.
